plans.idea: Classic leaderboard read left-to-right: logo lockup opens the strip, a wide centre text block carries a one-line headline over its subhead, and the square bottle closes on the right as in the original.

Faithful to the original's composition: left-aligned headline and subhead dominate the left two-thirds, the bottle sits immediately after the copy as the product beat, and the logo signs off at the right edge.

Brand-and-product lockup on the left (logo beside the bottle as one tight group) with the message given the entire right two-thirds, so the headline gets maximum size and the eye moves brand/product then message.
